verdict.rationale: LangGraph's multi-agent docs describe the main patterns for building multi-agent systems that coordinate specialized components (docs-21, docs-39). They also show how to embed other patterns as nodes in one custom workflow that mixes deterministic and agentic steps (docs-12, docs-19), and streaming exposes subgraphs (docs-7). Community comments confirm it is a real Pregel-based orchestration layer with cycles and parallelism (comm-1). Missing for 10: the specific handoff and subagent mechanics are never shown in the evidence, there is no explicit crew-style coordination detail, and there is no hands-on corroboration of a multi-agent build.
